items.notes: HLD covers problem definition, candidate options, recommendation, blueprint applicability, traceability, scenarios, NFR, risks, ADR candidates and implementation design triggers.

items.notes: Matrix covers ExperimentFamilyManifest, MultipleTestingEvidence, DataSnoopingEvidence, OverfitRiskEvidence, WalkForwardEvidence, EconomicCostEvidence and CapacityLiquidityEvidence with all required columns.

items.notes: typed_unavailable may allow labeled exploratory notes only; it blocks statistical significance, robustness, paper_candidate and production_like claims when evidence is mandatory.

items.name: CR151/CR154 integration does not create a parallel gate family
items.notes: CR161 evidence feeds existing CR151 statistical and CR154 reliability refs/summaries.

items.name: CR155 is preserved as blocked negative regression only
items.notes: CR155 remains blocked_admission_failed and paper_candidate=false; missing historical C1/C2 facts are not reconstructed.

items.name: Current slice truthfulness and follow-up split are explicit
items.notes: HLD states current slice is typed_unavailable contract semantics only, not computable FDR/PBO/DSR, fold-level OOS, real TCA or capacity implementation; FU-CR161-001..005 are defined.

items.name: Blueprint applicability is evaluated
items.notes: Standalone BLUEPRINT/DOMAIN-MAP/DEPENDENCY-MAP outputs are waived for this CP3-only design slice and must be revisited before any implementation route.

items.name: No unauthorized implementation, runtime, data, credential, external or publish action is included
items.notes: Only design/check artifacts were produced; no source code or tests are part of this CP3 output.
